summary.text: Dave Murman is a member of the Nebraska Legislature (Unicameral) representing District 38, serving since 2018 (elected 2018, re-elected 2022). His committee assignments are Education and Revenue.

paragraphs.text: According to his legislative biography, Murman was born June 30, 1953, in Hastings and graduated from Sandy Creek High School in 1971.
He earned a B.S. in animal science from the University of Nebraska-Lincoln in 1976.
His biography lists his occupation as farmer, with past work as a dairy farmer, and service as president of the Nebraska State Dairy Association and as an EMT with Glenvil Fire and Rescue.
It lists him as married to Kathy J. Hinrichs since August 5, 1977, with three children.
